raw.description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.
We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Requirements

  • 8+ years professional software development experience, with 3+ years in an architecture-focused role
  • Deep experience designing low-latency service architectures in AWS, including judgment about when distributed components (queues, caches, search projections) earn their place
  • Experience designing to explicit latency budgets (p95/p99), including synchronous durable commits in hot paths
  • Experience designing audit/evidence systems: append-only event logs, versioned or bitemporal fact models, and deterministic historical replay
  • Experience designing fail-open/fail-closed/degraded-state semantics and outage postures
  • Proven experience architecting secure multi-tenant environments, including tradeoff analysis (RLS vs. schema-per-tenant vs. database-per-tenant)
  • Deep experience with PostgreSQL/AuroraDB and Row-Level Security (RLS) at a data-modeling and architecture level
  • Expertise in designing and building scalable RESTful APIs
  • Experience architecting SDK integrations to other services
  • Strong expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript across the stack
  • Experience building capacity models and cloud cost/performance projections (AWS Well-Architected Framework)
  • Experience establishing technical standards, conducting architecture and code reviews, and mentoring engineering teams
  • Experience producing architecture documentation, diagrams, and technical decision records (ADRs)
  • Experience presenting and defending architecture decisions in client engineering and security reviews
  • Experience working with AI coding assistants as part of daily development
  • Substantial background architecting large, complex systems end-to-end
  • Ability to overlap US business hours
  • Bachelor's degree required
  • Extreme ownership and accountability for deliverables
  • Client-focused dedication to team commitments
  • Best practices knowledge and adherence
  • Strong problem-solving ability and technical leadership skills
  • Positive mindset and can-do attitude
  • Meticulous attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in compliance-sensitive or regulated domains (e.g., TCPA/DNC, fintech decisioning, audit-heavy systems)
  • Experience with event-driven design, message queues, and caching strategies at scale
  • Advanced degree

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications
Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

raw.title: Technical Architect - Boomi
raw.excerpt: Job SummaryWe are seeking a skilled Boomi Integration Architect with deep experience in architecting, designing, and governing integrations between enterprise applications.
raw.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Boomi Integration Architect with deep experience in architecting, designing, and governing integrations between enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should have extensive hands-on experience with the Boomi Enterprise Platform and a strong understanding of API strategy and lifecycle governance, master data management, system integrations, EDI and data transformation.

The candidate should be comfortable working with multiple enterprise systems such as NetSuite, SAP, D365, Workday, or Salesforce. The candidate should also be experienced in database and file-based integrations. Strong communication skills are essential to effectively lead architecture discussions with business and technical stakeholders, define integration strategy, and deliver scalable solutions.

The candidate should have experience owning the integration architecture across multiple concurrent projects and teams. This includes defining reference architectures and standards, establishing governance, overseeing code reviews and deployment strategy, and providing technical direction to development teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and own end-to-end integration architecture, including runtime topology (Atom, Molecule, Atom Cloud, Private Cloud), environment strategy, and deployment models.
  • Establish integration standards, reusable frameworks, design patterns, and reference architectures adopted across delivery teams.
  • Oversee the design, development, testing, and deployment of integrations built on the Boomi platform, providing hands-on guidance where needed.
  • Architect integrations between enterprise systems such as NetSuite, SAP, D365, Workday, or Salesforce, and other third-party applications.
  • Define API strategy and standards, including REST/SOAP design, versioning, and use of the REST Client connector.
  • Deep familiarity with the Boomi Enterprise Platform, including Integration, APIM, DataHub, Flow, Event Streams, and AgentStudio
  • Design and implement scalable integration workflows and reusable components using tools such as REST APIs, message queues, and other cloud-based solutions.
  • Define data mapping, transformation, and validation approaches, and review implementations for quality and consistency.
  • Establish monitoring, alerting, logging, and error handling standards; lead root cause analysis on complex production issues.
  • Own performance, scalability, and capacity planning for the integration platform.
  • Define security architecture for integrations, including authentication, authorization, secrets management, and data protection.
  • Lead current-state assessments, target-state design, and migration roadmaps (including legacy or competing iPaaS to Boomi).
  • Partner with business stakeholders and enterprise architects to translate business requirements into integration solution designs.
  • Provide effort estimates, solution options, and level-of-effort inputs for proposals and statements of work.
  • Mentor senior and junior developers; chair design reviews and architecture review boards.
  • Own architecture documentation, including solution design documents, integration catalogs, and API specifications.

Experience:

  • Advanced English communication skills
  • 12+ years of experience in enterprise application integration
  • 5+ years of hands-on Boomi design and development experience
  • Proven experience architecting and delivering large-scale, multi-system Boomi programs
  • Experience working in enterprise integration environments with hybrid cloud/on-premise systems
  • Experience owning integration architecture across multiple workstreams and mentoring developers and senior developers
  • Experience performing code reviews, deployment management, and production support
  • Experience defining integration standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices at an enterprise or program level
  • Experience presenting architecture and solution recommendations to senior client stakeholders, including IT leadership
  • Experience collaborating directly with business stakeholders, architects, QA teams, and project managers
  • Experience with integration monitoring, incident management, and root cause analysis
  • Experience supporting production environments with SLA-driven support models
  • Experience estimating integration effort and contributing to technical solution design
  • Experience with platform governance, licensing/connector consumption planning, and total cost of ownership considerations
  • Consulting or client-facing experience required

Skill Requirements:

  • Strong hands-on experience with the Boomi Enterprise Platform
  • Expertise in designing and implementing integrations using REST APIs, SOAP services, webhooks, and event-driven architectures
  • Ability to select and justify integration patterns (batch, real-time, event-driven, pub/sub, API-led) based on business and technical constraints
  • Experience with Boomi components including: Integration, API Management (APIM), DataHub / Master Data Hub, Flow, EDI, Event Streams, AgentStudio
  • Experience developing integrations with enterprise platforms such as: NetSuite, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Workday, Salesforce, Oracle ERP / HCM, ServiceNow
  • Strong knowledge of API lifecycle management, authentication, and security standards including: OAuth 2.0, JWT, Basic Authentication, SAML, API Gateway concepts
  • Experience working with: REST and SOAP web services; XML, JSON, CSV, flat files; XSLT and data transformation; database integrations (SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL)
  • Familiarity with messaging and event technologies such as: JMS, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, AWS SQS/SNS
  • Experience with EDI transaction processing including ANSI X12 and EDIFACT
  • Knowledge of CI/CD and DevOps practices for integration deployments
  • Experience with Git, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar tools
  • Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and performance optimization skills
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including networking, identity, and hosting considerations for integration runtimes
  • Ability to design scalable, reusable, and maintainable integration frameworks
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to lead technical discussions and mentor developers at all levels
  • Ability to produce architecture artifacts: solution design documents, sequence and data flow diagrams, and interface specifications

Required or strongly preferred:

  • Boomi Architect Certification
  • Boomi Professional Developer Certification
  • Boomi Professional Integration Developer Certification
  • Boomi API Management Certification
  • Boomi Master Data Hub Certification
  • MuleSoft, TOGAF, or other iPaaS-related or architecture certifications are a plus

Education:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

raw.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD98261

Position Overview

The Enterprise Technical Sales Specialist is a trusted technical advisor responsible for validating, architecting, and demonstrating complex Autodesk solutions for enterprise customers within a defined industry or vertical. This role partners closely with Enterprise Account Executives (EAEs), Account Technical Leads (ATLs), and Customer Success teams to align technical solutions to customer business outcomes.

Operating at a fully proficient level, this role leads advanced technical engagements, supports pilots and proof‑of‑concepts, contributes reusable technical content, and mentor junior specialists. While primarily aligned to a core vertical, the role may also support multi‑industry expansion efforts where broader technical coverage is needed.This position is open to individuals with deep knowledge of AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Operations), AI & Data Management, and Platform Services.

Responsibilities

Customer Advising & Solution Architecture

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor, aligning Autodesk solutions to customer business objectives

  • Partner with ATLs to contribute domain expertise to the creation and delivery of the Customer Technical Vision (CTV)

  • Architect end‑to‑end technical solutions that address complex enterprise workflows and business challenges

Technical Demonstrations & Validation

  • Lead high‑impact, customized technical demonstrations and ROI‑based solution storytelling

  • Design and execute pilots and proof‑of‑concepts, ensuring technical feasibility and success criteria alignment

  • Address complex technical objections and guide customers through validation decisions

Commercial & Proposal Support

  • Architect technical components of enterprise proposals involving multiple Autodesk products

  • Quantify business impact, technical value, and integration considerations to support deal progression

Domain Expertise & Enablement

  • Apply deep industry or vertical expertise to solution design and customer engagement

  • Build highly customized demo assets tailored to key enterprise customers and strategic opportunities

  • Create reusable technical assets, documentation, and enablement content to scale best practices

Who is Credible?

Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level. On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score. On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.

About the role

Our Business Intelligence and Analytics team is seeking to grow the company’s Data Science and Machine Learning capabilities across several facets of our business. We are seeking a seasoned Data Scientist to lead this transformative step change function and nurture its growth across several focus areas. You will drive tactical and strategic execution of several data science projects and manage their entire lifecycle.

You will:

  • Drive the long-term statistical modeling and machine learning vision of the company.
  • Conducting exploratory data analysis (EDA) prior to model development
  • Performing feasibility assessments (POCs) for proposed ML solutions
  • Monitoring and diagnosing model performance issues, including drift and degradation
  • Researching and evaluating additional use cases for existing models
  • Supporting ad hoc ML-related analytics requests from stakeholders and senior data scientists
  • Conduct analysis to develop and improve our product recommendation and user classification systems. Use this understanding to help optimize our adaptive user experience, cross selling initiatives, and retargeting efforts.
  • Design, prototype, and implement models across several domains. Manage each part of a project’s life cycle, including ad-hoc exploration, preparation of training data, model development, and production deployment.
  • Work with product and marketing managers, analysts, and engineers to turn insights about our users into automated services.

Education and Experience:

  • BA/BS in Mathematics, Statistics, or Computer Science required. Masters Degree in a quantitative or scientific discipline strongly desired.
  • 3+ years experience in developing, testing, and deploying optimized predictive models (preferably to inform in-product recommendation systems and automated customer re-targeting efforts).
  • Advanced statistical modeling skillset (Python, R, etc).
  • Advanced SQL querying, data mining, and data cleansing skillset.
  • Deep knowledge of supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms (neural networks, decision trees, etc.).
  • Advanced knowledge of experiment design.
  • Experience with Seldon-core or other MLOps tools is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure tools (AWS EC2, S3, Redshift, Snowflake, containers).
  • Advanced visualization/reporting and presentation experience.
  • Version Control Experience (GitHub).
  • Demonstrated experience adopting and effectively leveraging AI tools in day-to-day data science workflows.
  • Familiarity with ML deployment infrastructure (ETL, tools, new products in the space).
  • Excellent strategic project planning skillset.
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Experience at an e-commerce or fintech company is a plus.

Must Haves:

  • Ability to develop project plans and deliver results against quarterly and annual roadmaps.
  • Comfortable working with loosely defined requirements where you exercise your creativity and analytical skills to deliver best in class solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Ability to articulate vision, complex thoughts, analytical processes, and results in clear business terms.
  • Anticipate business needs and think with a business owner mindset – think critically about analyses and solutions and provide improvement recommendations. This role requires an individual who can work autonomously.

Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay ranges for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location, are listed below. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents.

View more details about Credible Benefits

For high cost of labor markets such as but not limited to New York City and San Francisco:
$102,000—$136,000 USD
For all other US locations:
$89,000—$124,000 USD

Why work at Credible?

We combine the intelligence, expertise, and confidence of a financial advisor with the approachability and honesty of a friend. In other words, we’re the friend you always wish you had in finance.

We are optimistic, challengers, trustworthy, clever, and smart. We are open and transparent. We strive to act as advisors by being friendly, objective, and open in our communication. We use language that is intelligent yet approachable. When appropriate, we’ll drop in a bit of wit to position ourselves as a fresh, reliable voice in the financial world.

About Us:

Pacvue is the leading Commerce Media OS, powering over $12B in advertising spend across 100+ global retail media networks including Amazon, Walmart, Target, Kroger, Instacart, Criteo, and CitrusAd. Powered by industry-leading AI and real-time data, Pacvue enables over 70,000 brands and agencies to maximize advertising performance, drive incrementality, and expand reach across the commerce universe from a single mission control. As of 2025, Pacvue powers 12% of total retail media ad spend worldwide excluding China. Combined with Helium 10’s SMB solutions, Pacvue delivers the industry’s most comprehensive platform for businesses of all sizes.

At Pacvue and Helium 10, great careers don’t just happen — they’re built. Here, you’ll rise as an industry leader, push the boundaries of innovation, own your journey, and thrive as part of an inclusive global community that’s redefining the future of commerce.

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Sr. Retail Media Display Account Manager to develop and execute digital media strategies on behalf of clients. As a Sr. Display Account Manager, you will be responsible for driving superior business results through strong relationship building, developing an in-depth knowledge of the client's business goals and objectives, understanding the categories in which they compete to strategically grow share, while providing solid reporting and analytics to demonstrate success against joint business plans.

This role will be focused on Amazon DSP, with training responsibilities intended to educate our clients on DSP best practices and demonstrate how to integrate complex DSP campaigns into a cohesive, full-funnel advertising program. In addition, depending on client needs and business priorities, you may also lead onboarding initiatives from contract execution through go-live, including temporary hands-on campaign setup, optimization, and client training delivery.

We are looking for a self-starter with a proven track record of building relationships and taking full ownership of client inputs to deliver results. The ideal candidate will deliver an excellent client experience and execute at both a strategic and tactical level to deliver growth for our clients across various retail media platforms, with a heavy focus on Amazon DSP. This includes activities such as creating and managing display media strategies for various retailers, providing annual and ongoing budget recommendations to help clients achieve their business objectives, highlighting other operational KPIs or opportunities that impact advertising effectiveness, delivering regular reporting on advertising effectiveness, and—when assigned to onboarding workflows—conducting training and establishing foundational client configurations. This position requires a candidate who can easily dive deep into a data set, develop tactical strategies, and present their action plan to gain alignment with senior leaders.

Responsibilities:

Account Management & Strategic Growth

  • Fully own the client relationship by building solid rapport, demonstrating transparency, and delivering results against joint business objectives
  • Develop strategic growth plans, gain client alignment, and fully execute against the aligned upon approach
  • Develop annual budget recommendations and properly allocate across campaigns to align with high level business objectives
  • Develop an annual marketing calendar incorporating key drive periods (including relevant macro and micro seasons), new product launches, and clients' national media calendars
  • Leverage Pacvue technology to manage budget allocation, communicate with client on trends and pacing, and deliver results within client budget thresholds
  • Prepare weekly and monthly retail media performance reports, analyze category trends, measure advertising and total sales, identify account trends, and perform competitive benchmarking across the client's product portfolio
  • Maximize retailer share, revenue, and profitability for clients while integrating client's internal objectives such as driving innovation or key items or product lines
  • Create strategic retail media plans for new product launches, including recommendations for retail readiness across core KPIs

Performance Measurement & Analytics

  • Measure efficacy of the strategy through regular reporting against core retail media KPIs and ad-hoc audits to identify areas for refinement
  • Highlight incremental sales opportunities to clients through participation in retailer programs, additional promotional opportunities, and recommendations to improve operational KPIs
  • Responsible for reporting, analysis, and communication with Pacvue and client management teams

DSP Expertise

  • Act as Amazon DSP expert within broader Pacvue team, with potential to train and educate internal teams on DSP best practices

Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience working in eCommerce advertising, marketing, account management, or related digital marketing functions
  • 3+ years of previous client-facing account management experience
  • An in-depth knowledge of display media advertising, with prior Amazon DSP experience
  • Demonstrated expertise in advertising technology platforms, with preference for experience using Pacvue or similar retail media DSP technology
  • Demonstrate understanding of how retail media, sales, and operations work together to successfully drive an eCommerce business
  • Proven track record in relationship building and account management
  • Proven success in driving results and implementing ideas in a fast-paced environment
  • Works efficiently and is always looking to streamline processes and workflows
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Moderate Excel and PowerPoint skills are a must
  • Previous product management, project management, financial analysis, negotiation and/or marketing experience is a plus
  • Commitment to a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous learning
  • Self-starter with the ability to thrive in a fast-growing, evolving environment

Benefits:

  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Paid Holidays and Floating Holidays
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA, HSA with employer contribution, Life Insurance and Pet Insurance
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • Take up to 2 Days of Paid Time Off to Volunteer with a 501c Organization
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Company-subsidized membership to Wellhub and Peloton
  • Fertility and family-building information platform through Carrot

The annual base salary range for this position is $105,000-$130,000 USD. The actual salary will vary depending on the applicant’s experience, skills, and abilities as well as internal equity and market data for their location. This position is also eligible for an additional annual bonus compensation through one of Pacvue’s highly attractive incentive plans, full details will be provided during the recruitment process.

Pacvue is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

Innovation is and will always be the core of SAP Fioneer, and it is the promise of why we were spun out of SAP: agility, innovation, and delivery.

SAP Fioneer builds on a heritage of outstanding technology and a deep understanding of corporate and consumer demands. At the heart of it all it is simple: We bring financial services to the next level with innovative software solutions and platforms.

We are helping companies in the financial services industry to achieve speed, scalability, and cost-efficiency through digital business innovation, cloud technology, and solutions that cover banking and insurance processes end-to-end.

A global company, with rapid growth, innovative people, and a lean organization makes SAP Fioneer a place where you accelerate your future!

About role

As a Lead SAP ABAP Engineer you will drive the backend architecture and delivery of our cloud-based SaaS platform built on S/4HANA and SAP BTP technologies. You will design, develop and maintain scalable, secure, high-performance components, own technical decisions, and ensure clean‑core, upgrade‑safe extensibility across our Fioneer solutions. In this role you will lead and mentor a small team of ABAP engineers, collaborate closely with product owners, UX/Fiori leads and cross-functional stakeholders, and translate business needs into robust backend APIs, CDS/OData services and integration patterns.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, shaping architecture, and growing engineering talent while contributing to a next‑generation SaaS platform, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Design, own and govern the architecture of scalable, secure backend components for innovative lending solutions built on ABAP and related SAP technologies.
  • Define technical direction, coding standards, and best practices; drive adoption of clean‑core, upgrade‑safe extension patterns across teams.
  • Lead implementation efforts, review designs and code, and ensure delivery of high‑quality standard software in an agile environment while collaborating with internal stakeholders, customers and partners.
  • Partner strategically with front‑end developers, designers, and product owners to define end‑to‑end solutions, APIs (CDS/OData) and integration patterns.
  • Diagnose, prioritize and resolve complex technical issues; coordinate incident response and post‑mortem actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Ensure engineering excellence through structured testing strategies (unit, integration, UAT support), CI/CD pipelines, automated quality checks, performance tuning and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Mentor and grow ABAP engineers: conduct code reviews, provide technical coaching, run knowledge‑sharing sessions and support career development.
  • Create, maintain and approve comprehensive technical documentation, runbooks and architectural artefacts.
  • Drive platform readiness for cloud deployments, oversee security, observability and governance, and lead upgrade/migration planning.
  • Stay current with innovations in S/4HANA, RAP and SAP BTP and evaluate their adoption to advance the platform roadmap.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in ABAP object-oriented development, with substantial hands‑on work on S/4HANA (experience in the financial sector is a plus).
  • Proven track record (3+ years) leading and mentoring engineering teams, driving technical decisions and delivery in enterprise SAP projects.
  • Deep proficiency in OData, Core Data Services (CDS), and ABAP RESTful Application Programming (RAP).
  • Practical experience with SAP BTP (services, deployment approaches, integration concepts) and cloud readiness for enterprise solutions.
  • Strong architecture and design skills: defining extension patterns, clean‑core strategies, multi‑tenant SaaS considerations, and upgrade‑safe solutions.
  • Experience with CI/CD for ABAP, automated testing strategies, performance tuning, observability, and operational readiness.
  • Familiarity with modern SAP development tools (Business Application Studio, Eclipse, or Visual Studio Code).
  • Excellent problem‑solving and decision‑making skills; ability to break down technical complexity and balance risks.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; experienced collaborating with product, UX/Fiori, DevOps and business teams.
  • Fluent in English.

Nice-to-have

  • Certification in S/4HANA, SAP BTP, or related SAP technologies.
  • Domain experience with banking products and processes (e.g., retail lending, regulatory reporting).
  • Full‑stack experience with SAP UI5/Fiori or close collaboration history with UI leads.
  • Hands‑on experience with SAP HANA (AMDP, performance modeling).
  • Exposure to event‑driven architectures and integration patterns on SAP BTP.
  • Experience working in agile frameworks (Scrum / SAFe) and leading international, cross‑functional teams.

Benefits

You will have the opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry on an incredibly ambitious project to shape the ever-evolving financial sector. This is an environment where you can have it all - the agility, enthusiasm and dynamism of a start-up, combined with the established expertise, solid market presence and extensive customer network of a more established organisation.

At SAP Fioneer, you will benefit from a flexible work environment that encourages creativity and encourages you to think outside the box, bring new ideas to the table, and challenge the status quo. You will become part of a diverse and global team that we are proud of and are constantly growing and reinventing. As an employee, you will have the chance to chart your own career path and take advantage of competitive compensation packages and progression opportunities based on merit.

We offer pension plans and life insurance for financial security. Our health and wellbeing benefits include private medical insurance, wellness cover, and an employee assistance program. Additionally, our mobility benefits vary based on seniority level and include company car benefits and transportation assistance. Furthermore, we provide additional perks such as celebration rewards, a jubilee program, and a meal program.

raw.title: Director, Product Strategy & Transformation
raw.excerpt: About the RoleMillions of professionals rely on Wolters Kluwer to make critical decisions across healthcare, tax, legal, financial services, compliance and corporate performance.
raw.description:
About the Role

Millions of professionals rely on Wolters Kluwer to make critical decisions across healthcare, tax, legal, financial services, compliance and corporate performance. As AI reshapes professional work, our customers expect software that is more intelligent, integrated and effective. Meeting those expectations requires rethinking how products are discovered, built, launched, measured and improved.

This newly created role reflects Wolters Kluwer's commitment to transforming how products are built in the age of AI. Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Product Strategy & Transformation, you will help lead that evolution from the Corporate Strategy Office. Working in a small enterprise team, you will partner with senior product, engineering, design and business leaders to strengthen the Product System and improve customer value, business outcomes and speed of innovation. A key focus will be advancing the Agentic Product Development Lifecycle (Agentic PDLC), using AI across product development. You will combine deep product expertise with a hands-on transformation mindset to implement and scale change.

How You Will Work

This is a senior individual-contributor role, leading through expertise, coaching, facilitation and influence. You will embed with business-unit teams on high-priority lighthouse initiatives, apply modern product practices and AI-enabled workflows, and turn proven approaches into reusable tools and operating practices for broader adoption.

The role can be based remotely in any country where Wolters Kluwer has an office and will require travel of approximately 35% to work directly with teams and stakeholders.

What You Will Do

  • Partner with senior product, engineering, design and business leaders to identify high-impact opportunities and connect product decisions to customer and business outcomes.
  • Define, pilot and scale Wolters Kluwer's Agentic PDLC and broader AI-enabled product development capabilities.
  • Lead lighthouse engagements across product strategy, discovery, experimentation, delivery, launch and measurement.
  • Embed with cross-functional teams to diagnose barriers, build trust and translate insight into practical change.
  • Coach product leaders and improve operating models, portfolio practices, governance and metrics.
  • Turn effective practices into repeatable tools, learning experiences and standards for enterprise adoption.
  • Establish success measures, demonstrate impact and use evidence to guide broader rollout.

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • 8+ years of hands-on Product Management and/or Product Leadership experience in B2B software, SaaS or technology companies.
  • Ownership of strategy and outcomes for a substantial product, platform or portfolio, from customer discovery through delivery and measurement.
  • A track record of leading cross-functional product, engineering and design teams to meaningful customer and business outcomes.
  • Strong product craft across discovery, strategy, experimentation, prioritization, roadmaps, launch and measurement.
  • Recent hands-on experience building AI-enabled or agentic products, transforming product development workflows through AI, or both.
  • Ability to enter unfamiliar contexts, diagnose root causes, build trust and translate insight into action.
  • Proven influence on product direction, operating models or organizational effectiveness beyond a single team, without relying on formal authority.
  • Strong analytical, communication, storytelling and facilitation skills, with the judgment to simplify complexity and align senior leaders.

Preferred Experience

  • Leading product transformation, operating-model change or organizational scaling initiatives.
  • Coaching product leaders and strengthening product management practices.
  • Working across multiple businesses, portfolios or complex matrixed organizations.
  • Scaling reusable capabilities such as playbooks, metrics, communities of practice or leadership-development programs.

What Makes Someone Successful

  • Customer obsessed and focused on solving meaningful professional problems.
  • Passionate about product craft and motivated by helping multiple teams become more effective.
  • Curious, adaptable and energized by ambiguity, with high ownership and a bias toward action.
  • Strong product judgment balanced with evidence-based decision-making.
  • Pragmatic and hands-on, able to challenge the status quo, build followership and move from strategy to implementation.

Why This Role Matters

This role is designed for accomplished product leaders who have successfully built products, led teams and delivered meaningful business outcomes and are ready to extend their impact beyond a single product, platform or portfolio. Rather than owning one roadmap, you will help shape how product strategy, discovery, delivery and AI-enabled product development are practiced across a global software company. Your influence will be reflected not only in individual initiatives, but in stronger teams, faster learning, better decision-making and improved outcomes for the millions of professionals who rely on Wolters Kluwer every day.

If you are motivated by helping define product excellence, shaping AI-native ways of working and influencing the future of product development at enterprise scale, this is a unique opportunity to leave a lasting imprint across an entire global portfolio.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Compensation:

$137,900.00 - $246,350.00 USDThis role is eligible for Bonus.

Compensation range listed is based on primary location of the position. Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific offer for the job location during the hiring process.

Additional Information:

Wolters Kluwer offers a wide variety of competitive benefits and programs to help meet your needs and balance your work and personal life, including but not limited to: Medical, Dental, & Vision Plans, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Commuter Benefits, Tuition Assistance Plan, Vacation and Sick Time, and Paid Parental Leave. Full details of our benefits are available upon request.

raw.description:
About Us:

Pacvue is the leading Commerce Media OS, powering over $12B in advertising spend across 100+ global retail media networks including Amazon, Walmart, Target, Kroger, Instacart, Criteo, and CitrusAd. Powered by industry-leading AI and real-time data, Pacvue enables over 70,000 brands and agencies to maximize advertising performance, drive incrementality, and expand reach across the commerce universe from a single mission control. As of 2025, Pacvue powers 12% of total retail media ad spend worldwide excluding China. Combined with Helium 10’s SMB solutions, Pacvue delivers the industry’s most comprehensive platform for businesses of all sizes.

At Pacvue and Helium 10, great careers don’t just happen — they’re built. Here, you’ll rise as an industry leader, push the boundaries of innovation, own your journey, and thrive as part of an inclusive global community that’s redefining the future of commerce.

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Sr. Retail Media Display Account Manager to develop and execute digital media strategies on behalf of clients. As a Sr. Display Account Manager, you will be responsible for driving superior business results through strong relationship building, developing an in-depth knowledge of the client's business goals and objectives, understanding the categories in which they compete to strategically grow share, while providing solid reporting and analytics to demonstrate success against joint business plans.

This role will be focused on Amazon DSP, with training responsibilities intended to educate our clients on DSP best practices and demonstrate how to integrate complex DSP campaigns into a cohesive, full-funnel advertising program. In addition, depending on client needs and business priorities, you may also lead onboarding initiatives from contract execution through go-live, including temporary hands-on campaign setup, optimization, and client training delivery.

We are looking for a self-starter with a proven track record of building relationships and taking full ownership of client inputs to deliver results. The ideal candidate will deliver an excellent client experience and execute at both a strategic and tactical level to deliver growth for our clients across various retail media platforms, with a heavy focus on Amazon DSP. This includes activities such as creating and managing display media strategies for various retailers, providing annual and ongoing budget recommendations to help clients achieve their business objectives, highlighting other operational KPIs or opportunities that impact advertising effectiveness, delivering regular reporting on advertising effectiveness, and—when assigned to onboarding workflows—conducting training and establishing foundational client configurations. This position requires a candidate who can easily dive deep into a data set, develop tactical strategies, and present their action plan to gain alignment with senior leaders.

Responsibilities:

Account Management & Strategic Growth

  • Fully own the client relationship by building solid rapport, demonstrating transparency, and delivering results against joint business objectives
  • Develop strategic growth plans, gain client alignment, and fully execute against the aligned upon approach
  • Develop annual budget recommendations and properly allocate across campaigns to align with high level business objectives
  • Develop an annual marketing calendar incorporating key drive periods (including relevant macro and micro seasons), new product launches, and clients' national media calendars
  • Leverage Pacvue technology to manage budget allocation, communicate with client on trends and pacing, and deliver results within client budget thresholds
  • Prepare weekly and monthly retail media performance reports, analyze category trends, measure advertising and total sales, identify account trends, and perform competitive benchmarking across the client's product portfolio
  • Maximize retailer share, revenue, and profitability for clients while integrating client's internal objectives such as driving innovation or key items or product lines
  • Create strategic retail media plans for new product launches, including recommendations for retail readiness across core KPIs

Performance Measurement & Analytics

  • Measure efficacy of the strategy through regular reporting against core retail media KPIs and ad-hoc audits to identify areas for refinement
  • Highlight incremental sales opportunities to clients through participation in retailer programs, additional promotional opportunities, and recommendations to improve operational KPIs
  • Responsible for reporting, analysis, and communication with Pacvue and client management teams

DSP Expertise

  • Act as Amazon DSP expert within broader Pacvue team, with potential to train and educate internal teams on DSP best practices

Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience working in eCommerce advertising, marketing, account management, or related digital marketing functions
  • 3+ years of previous client-facing account management experience
  • An in-depth knowledge of display media advertising, with prior Amazon DSP experience
  • Demonstrated expertise in advertising technology platforms, with preference for experience using Pacvue or similar retail media DSP technology
  • Demonstrate understanding of how retail media, sales, and operations work together to successfully drive an eCommerce business
  • Proven track record in relationship building and account management
  • Proven success in driving results and implementing ideas in a fast-paced environment
  • Works efficiently and is always looking to streamline processes and workflows
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Moderate Excel and PowerPoint skills are a must
  • Previous product management, project management, financial analysis, negotiation and/or marketing experience is a plus
  • Commitment to a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous learning
  • Self-starter with the ability to thrive in a fast-growing, evolving environment

Benefits:

  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Paid Holidays and Floating Holidays
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA, HSA with employer contribution, Life Insurance and Pet Insurance
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • Take up to 2 Days of Paid Time Off to Volunteer with a 501c Organization
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Company-subsidized membership to Wellhub and Peloton
  • Fertility and family-building information platform through Carrot

The annual base salary range for this position is $105,000-$130,000 USD. The actual salary will vary depending on the applicant’s experience, skills, and abilities as well as internal equity and market data for their location. This position is also eligible for an additional annual bonus compensation through one of Pacvue’s highly attractive incentive plans, full details will be provided during the recruitment process.

Pacvue is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

raw.excerpt: About the RoleMillions of professionals rely on Wolters Kluwer to make critical decisions across healthcare, tax, legal, financial services, compliance and corporate performance.
raw.description:
About the Role

Millions of professionals rely on Wolters Kluwer to make critical decisions across healthcare, tax, legal, financial services, compliance and corporate performance. As AI reshapes professional work, our customers expect software that is more intelligent, integrated and effective. Meeting those expectations requires rethinking how products are discovered, built, launched, measured and improved.

This newly created role reflects Wolters Kluwer's commitment to transforming how products are built in the age of AI. Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Product Strategy & Transformation, you will help lead that evolution from the Corporate Strategy Office. Working in a small enterprise team, you will partner with senior product, engineering, design and business leaders to strengthen the Product System and improve customer value, business outcomes and speed of innovation. A key focus will be advancing the Agentic Product Development Lifecycle (Agentic PDLC), using AI across product development. You will combine deep product expertise with a hands-on transformation mindset to implement and scale change.

How You Will Work

This is a senior individual-contributor role, leading through expertise, coaching, facilitation and influence. You will embed with business-unit teams on high-priority lighthouse initiatives, apply modern product practices and AI-enabled workflows, and turn proven approaches into reusable tools and operating practices for broader adoption.

The role can be based remotely in any country where Wolters Kluwer has an office and will require travel of approximately 35% to work directly with teams and stakeholders.

What You Will Do

  • Partner with senior product, engineering, design and business leaders to identify high-impact opportunities and connect product decisions to customer and business outcomes.
  • Define, pilot and scale Wolters Kluwer's Agentic PDLC and broader AI-enabled product development capabilities.
  • Lead lighthouse engagements across product strategy, discovery, experimentation, delivery, launch and measurement.
  • Embed with cross-functional teams to diagnose barriers, build trust and translate insight into practical change.
  • Coach product leaders and improve operating models, portfolio practices, governance and metrics.
  • Turn effective practices into repeatable tools, learning experiences and standards for enterprise adoption.
  • Establish success measures, demonstrate impact and use evidence to guide broader rollout.

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • 8+ years of hands-on Product Management and/or Product Leadership experience in B2B software, SaaS or technology companies.
  • Ownership of strategy and outcomes for a substantial product, platform or portfolio, from customer discovery through delivery and measurement.
  • A track record of leading cross-functional product, engineering and design teams to meaningful customer and business outcomes.
  • Strong product craft across discovery, strategy, experimentation, prioritization, roadmaps, launch and measurement.
  • Recent hands-on experience building AI-enabled or agentic products, transforming product development workflows through AI, or both.
  • Ability to enter unfamiliar contexts, diagnose root causes, build trust and translate insight into action.
  • Proven influence on product direction, operating models or organizational effectiveness beyond a single team, without relying on formal authority.
  • Strong analytical, communication, storytelling and facilitation skills, with the judgment to simplify complexity and align senior leaders.

Preferred Experience

  • Leading product transformation, operating-model change or organizational scaling initiatives.
  • Coaching product leaders and strengthening product management practices.
  • Working across multiple businesses, portfolios or complex matrixed organizations.
  • Scaling reusable capabilities such as playbooks, metrics, communities of practice or leadership-development programs.

What Makes Someone Successful

  • Customer obsessed and focused on solving meaningful professional problems.
  • Passionate about product craft and motivated by helping multiple teams become more effective.
  • Curious, adaptable and energized by ambiguity, with high ownership and a bias toward action.
  • Strong product judgment balanced with evidence-based decision-making.
  • Pragmatic and hands-on, able to challenge the status quo, build followership and move from strategy to implementation.

Why This Role Matters

This role is designed for accomplished product leaders who have successfully built products, led teams and delivered meaningful business outcomes and are ready to extend their impact beyond a single product, platform or portfolio. Rather than owning one roadmap, you will help shape how product strategy, discovery, delivery and AI-enabled product development are practiced across a global software company. Your influence will be reflected not only in individual initiatives, but in stronger teams, faster learning, better decision-making and improved outcomes for the millions of professionals who rely on Wolters Kluwer every day.

If you are motivated by helping define product excellence, shaping AI-native ways of working and influencing the future of product development at enterprise scale, this is a unique opportunity to leave a lasting imprint across an entire global portfolio.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Compensation:

$137,900.00 - $246,350.00 USDThis role is eligible for Bonus.

Compensation range listed is based on primary location of the position. Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific offer for the job location during the hiring process.

Additional Information:

Wolters Kluwer offers a wide variety of competitive benefits and programs to help meet your needs and balance your work and personal life, including but not limited to: Medical, Dental, & Vision Plans, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Commuter Benefits, Tuition Assistance Plan, Vacation and Sick Time, and Paid Parental Leave. Full details of our benefits are available upon request.

raw.description:
APPLICATION DEADLINE: This opportunity will be taken offline based on applicant volume. We encourage you to apply today if interested.

We know the job search process can feel uncertain and want to be respectful of your time and interest. All candidates who apply online will receive application status updates via email. Thank you for considering M-Files as your next career opportunity.

Who we are:

M-Files is redefining how work gets done. Our context-first document management system offers purpose-built business use cases—spanning universal and industry-specific workflows—to enable secure collaboration, automate processes, and ensure governance.

Unlike traditional systems, M-Files organizes content around the context of your business, connecting documents to related people, projects, and transactions. With our unique metadata-driven architecture, organizations can model content in line with their business processes, unify information across silos, and apply AI at scale. The result is greater productivity, reduced risk, and smarter, faster decisions for over 6,000 customers in 100+ countries.

At M-Files, our Guiding Principles unite us across diverse cultures and personalities:

  1. Make It Happen – We set bold goals, take ownership, learn from mistakes, and relentlessly pursue results.
  2. Help Others – We lead with kindness, assume good intentions, hold one another accountable, and celebrate wins together.
  3. Love Customers – We put customers and partners at the heart of everything, delivering value with respect, fairness, and speed.

To learn more about us we encourage you to visit our company page.

To learn more about how we became a Certified Great Place to Work visit, Working at M-Files | Great Place to Work.

Summary of the role:

As our RFx Specialist, you will own the global RFx response process for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, tenders, due diligence questionnaires, and security questionnaires across M-Files.

Competitive bids often represent some of our largest and most strategic new-business opportunities. This role provides a dedicated point of accountability for ensuring responses are timely, compliant, persuasive, accurate, and consistent across territories and time zones.

Using an AI-powered response platform, you will qualify incoming opportunities, develop and coordinate responses, and bring together expertise from Sales, Sales Engineering, Product, Security, Finance, and Legal. You will also own and continuously improve a governed content library, helping ensure approved responses remain accurate, current, and reusable.

This is a highly collaborative but independently driven role for someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex, deadline-driven work and can balance speed, quality, sound judgment, and attention to detail in a global environment.

What you will be doing/Responsibilities and Duties:

RFx Strategy & Execution

  • Own the full lifecycle of RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, tenders, due diligence questionnaires, and security questionnaires from intake through submission and post-decision debrief, providing global coverage.
  • Apply a consistent qualification framework to incoming opportunities so efforts are focused where requirements, timelines, and solution fit support pursuing the opportunity.
  • Analyze solicitations and develop compliance matrices, response outlines, production schedules, and contributor timelines.
  • Develop compelling win themes, differentiators, and executive summaries that connect stated requirements to buyer outcomes rather than simply restating existing content.
  • Manage multiple deadline-driven submissions while maintaining a consistent global standard for quality, accuracy, and compliance.

AI-Enabled Response Management & Content Governance

  • Operate an AI-powered RFx response platform as a primary drafting engine, including prompt design, source grounding, and human verification and approval of AI-generated responses prior to submission.
  • Own, curate, and continuously improve a governed answer library and reusable content bank to ensure responses remain accurate, approved, current, and consistent across territories.
  • Establish structured review gates for compliance, technical accuracy, and overall response quality.
  • Review AI-generated content for potential issues including unverified claims, outdated information, generic language, or other inaccuracies.
  • Maintain strong version control, approval processes, documentation, and audit readiness across submissions.

Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration

  • Coordinate input from Sales, Sales Engineering, Product, Security, Finance, Legal, and other subject matter experts, often within tight timelines.
  • Serve as the central point of coordination and accountability for response quality, contributor progress, approvals, and submission readiness.
  • Track contributor progress, proactively remove obstacles where possible, and escalate risks early when additional support is needed.
  • Document and codify successful RFx practices into a repeatable playbook that establishes a consistent quality standard across global territories.
  • Ensure RFx activities remain aligned with broader GTM Operations priorities and reporting.

Public Sector, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Support the growing volume and complexity of public sector and regulated-industry requirements, including security, privacy, accessibility, and compliance documentation.
  • Identify, qualify, and track relevant publicly posted solicitations to expand the pool of opportunities considered by the business.
  • Track and report submission volume, cycle time, outcomes, and recurring win/loss themes.
  • Facilitate post-decision debriefs and use lessons learned to continuously improve response content, positioning, qualification criteria, and processes.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience managing RFPs, RFIs, bids, proposals, or similar competitive response processes.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to draft proposal content, including reviewing, verifying, and approving AI-generated responses before submission.
  • Strong knowledge of RFx best practices, including compliance matrices, response outlines, win themes, and structured review gates.
  • Excellent writing and editing skills with the ability to tailor existing content to specific customer requirements and create clear, persuasive responses.
  • Advanced Microsoft Word skills, along with solid proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex, deadline-driven submissions simultaneously without sacrificing quality or attention to detail.
  • Experience working with Salesforce and reporting on activity, outcomes, or other relevant performance measures.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to obtain timely input from busy senior colleagues and subject matter experts.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across multiple teams and time zones.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive business information with discretion.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing RFPs, bids, or proposals within B2B software or SaaS.
  • Familiarity with public sector bids and security frameworks or questionnaires such as FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001, CAIQ, and SIG.
  • Eastern Time Zone location to support collaboration across our global teams.

Participation in our Recruitment Process:

  1. Initial Screening w/People & Culture Team Member
  2. Hiring Manager (Vice President, GTM Operations)
  3. Internal Team Member/Stakeholder(s)

*Completed Recruitment Process Time Investment for Applicant: ~Approx. 2.5hrs

Why M-Files?

Own Work That Directly Supports Growth

Competitive bids can represent some of M-Files’ largest and most strategic new-business opportunities. You’ll have meaningful ownership of how we evaluate, develop, coordinate, and deliver RFx responses globally while helping establish a consistent standard for quality and execution.

Put AI to Work

AI is an important part of how this role gets work done. You’ll use AI-powered technology throughout the response process while applying the human judgment necessary to ensure every submission remains accurate, relevant, compliant, and persuasive.

Work Across the Business

You’ll collaborate with teams across Sales, Sales Engineering, Product, Security, Finance, Legal, and GTM Operations, giving you broad exposure to our business, technology, customers, and go-to-market strategy.

Build for Scale

Your impact will extend beyond individual submissions. You’ll help improve how M-Files approaches RFx work globally, from reusable content and governance to qualification, review processes, reporting, and continuous improvement.

A Culture Built on Trust

Our guiding principles, Make It Happen, Help Others, and Love Customers, shape how we work together every day. We value people who take ownership, collaborate across boundaries, use sound judgment, and continually look for better ways to get work done.

Benefits

What We Offer:

  • As remote enabled company our employees enjoy the flexibility to establish their own life/work balance
  • 10 paid holidays annually
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Matching 401K Plan (25% of employee's contribution up to the IRS max)
  • Health insurance (PPO and HDHP/HSA plans offered)
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Life insurance (1x employee salary)
  • Short-term disability (employer paid)
  • Long-term disability (employer paid)
  • Flexible Spending Plan (medical and dependent)

Caseware is one of Canada's original Fintech companies, having led the global audit and accounting software industry for over 30 years, with more than 500,000 users across 130 countries and available in 16 different languages. While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles!

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Solutions Consultant to join our team at Caseware, a leading SaaS organization. As a Solutions Consultant, you will be responsible for successfully leading our customers and prospective customers through exploration and evaluations of Caseware solutions. In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor, working collaboratively with accounting firms and organizations as they navigate critical decisions around technology modernization.

By taking a consultative approach, you will be their partner to guide them through all aspects of their software evaluation, helping them understand not only current solutions but also how emerging technologies, including AI and automation, can drive efficiency, enhance quality, and create new opportunities within their organizations. You will also liaise with team members in account management, training, professional services, support and product to help ensure customer needs are addressed on a timely basis, and professionally.

This role supports customers and internal stakeholders across North America and may require availability to accommodate meetings across Eastern Time (ET) to Pacific Time (PT) business hours, with notice, to effectively collaborate with clients, partners, and cross-functional teams.

❗This a full-time, permanent position

❗This a new vacancy

📍 Location:

The role is a remote role and is available to all applicants residing and eligible to work in Canada.

What you will be doing:

    • Partner with our Account Managers and other Solution Consultants in helping prospects and customers evaluate and plan to implement Caseware products, helping them understand how solutions can drive efficiency, enhance quality, and create new opportunities within their organizations.
    • Lead evaluation activities including presentations, trials & pilots, sharing information on solutions expertise and best practices with customers, while coordinating with technical or product SMEs where appropriate.
    • Strategize with customers on their migration & implementation journeys, from their existing accounting and audit tools, and work with them and the Professional Services team to ensure they have a clear direction and key requirements are addressed.
    • Support customer evaluations and implementations, providing information on tools, processes and resources to customers, and helping to ensure timelines and tasks remain on track.
    • Create and maintain product demonstration strategies, use cases and related assets that are value and benefit-driven, not feature walk throughs.
    • Act as the bridge between customers and Product teams, gathering and translating customer feedback into clear, actionable insights that inform product development while helping prospects understand how our roadmap addresses their business needs.
    • Attendance at Conferences and Events, maintaining relationships with customers and staying up to date with industry standards and trends.
    • Participate in speaking engagements and thought leadership events or publications, as comfortable.
    • Design and implementation of processes and systems to support the delivery of consistent, scalable services.  Assist in the development and execution of improvement plans internally that are scalable to support future growth.

What you will bring:

    Required:
    • At least 3 years experience preparing financial statements and/or performing Audit, Assurance, Review or Compilation engagements OR at least 3 years’ experience in customer-facing role (e.g., customer success, account management, implementation or project management) in a SAAS company serving the Accounting Profession.
    • Excellent written and oral communication and presentation skills.
    • Effective communicator with ability to understand and interpret stakeholder needs.
    • Understanding of, or strong interest in, AI-powered accounting solutions and the ability to discuss how AI can be applied to modern accounting, audit, and advisory workflows with clients and prospects.
    • Strong organization skills with experience tracking and managing multiple deliverables and tasks.
    • A resourceful self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment where initiative and problem-solving skills are required.
    • Have a sound understanding of technology within the audit and accountancy sector, or an enthusiasm to learn.
    Preferred:
    • Have direct experience utilizing CaseWare to create financial statements or perform engagements.
    • CPA, Charted Accountant or equivalent, with 3+ years Audit or Accounting experience.
    • Experience leading technology adoption, training, methodology, or other innovation efforts in an accounting firm.
    • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or related field
    • Experience and/or qualifications in project, product or program management.
    • Practical experience utilizing AI tools, including for software development.
    • Deep understanding of accounting, financial processes and technologies.
    • Experience with CRM systems and tools for sales and lead management
    • Product, Product Marketing, Sales experience, or experience working closely with those functional teams
    • Experience using Microsoft Office Suite and CRM software (E.g., Salesforce)
    • Experience documenting internal processes and identifying/implementing efficiency or quality improvements.

Salary Range

    The annual base salary for this position is between $110,000 CAD and $125,000 CAD per year.

    This role is also eligible for discretionary bonus and/or commission, as well as other benefits. Actual pay within the listed range will be determined based on factors such as transferable skills, relevant experience, market conditions, and primary work location. The posted range is subject to change and may be updated periodically.

What's in it for you:

▪️Innovation is at our core. We work with cutting-edge technology in accounting and financial reporting, constantly pushing the boundaries to create impactful software solutions.
▪️We are committed to a collaborative culture, where your ideas are valued, and knowledge sharing is encouraged within a supportive, inclusive team.
▪️Work-life balance is important to us. We offer flexible work options, remote opportunities, and generous time-off policies to ensure a healthy work-life balance.
▪️We offer competitive compensation, including a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits such as health insurance and retirement plans.
▪️We are driven by impactful work. Your contributions directly affect how our clients manage financial processes and drive their success.
▪️Recognition and rewards matter to us. We celebrate hard work through recognition programs, performance bonuses, and opportunities for career growth.
▪️We embrace global opportunities. Work on international projects and collaborate with a diverse, global team.

About Caseware:

Caseware's cutting-edge software products are meticulously designed for accounting firms, corporations, and governments. Our teams are continually collaborating, innovating, and building upon our existing suite of products. With a customer-focused mindset, we are building technology that is shaping what the future of audits, financial reporting, and financial data analytics will look like.
With a recent strategic investment from Hg Capital in 2020, Caseware is now in its next major growth phase as we double down on the people and products that have made Caseware so successful to date.
One of Caseware's core values is Many Voices, One Team and with that in mind, we're dedicated to building teams as diverse as our customers in an equitable and inclusive way. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Should you require accommodations or have any questions at any point during the application or interview process, please e-mail our People Operations team at .

AI Usage:

Background Check:

Executives and Senior Managers will undergo a Soft Credit Check as well. Candidates residing in the Netherlands and Germany are excluded from undergoing background checks via Certn.co

Security and Fraud:

UX Researcher II Job Description

Under general supervision, conduct research efforts and develop clear stories from insights that support partner and team alignment on user-focused goals. This includes collaborating with UX designers, product owners, product managers, and engineers to discover opportunities for future products and validate designs for product optimization.

In this role as a UX Researcher II, you will be responsible for:

  • Conduct and synthesize research projects including user interviews, usability testing sessions, surveys, card sorting, and contribute to A/B testing initiatives

  • Degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Anthropology, Social Science, Design Research, Psychology, Cognitive Science or related field
  • 3-5 years of experience in UX Research or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Proficiency in qualitative research methods including interviews, contextual inquiry and observational studies
  • Working knowledge of quantitative research methods including survey design and basic statistical analysis
  • Familiarity with mixed-methods research approaches
  • Experience with evaluative research including usability testing and heuristic evaluation
  • Exposure to generative and exploratory research techniques
  • Ability to execute research protocols and discussion guides
  • Experience with participant recruitment and screening
  • Understanding of research ethics and informed consent practices
  • Experience conducting research with diverse user groups

raw.description:
PTC Therapeutics is a global commercial biopharmaceutical company. For over 25 years our team has been deeply committed to a unified purpose: Extending life’s moments for children and adults living with a rare disease.

At PTC, we cultivate an inclusive culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team, fostering a strong sense of belonging.

Visit our website to learn more about our company and culture!
Site:

Job Description Summary:

The Patient Support Specialist at PTC supports rare disease patients (e.g., PKU) through focused case management for pediatric patients and their caregivers, as well as adult patients enrolled in PTC Cares. This role supports coordination of therapy initiation, managing patient-level logistical needs in collaboration with the Sales, Patient Engagement, and Case Manager teams, promoting long-term treatment adherence, and navigating life-stage transitions (e.g., childhood to adolescence, transition to adult care).

The Patient Support Specialist also serves as a PKU subject matter resource for the Patient Services team to promote consistent, high-quality patient support. This role does not provide medical advice but focuses on product training, adherence, and logistical responsibilities using approved materials.

The Patient Success Liaison supports adherence to relevant regulatory and compliance requirements and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as appropriate.

.

Job Description:

Responsibilities:

  • Educate patients and caregivers on disease state, medication safety, administration and storage via phone/video and other approved channels.
  • Work hand-in-hand with Sales, Patient Engagement, and Case Manager teams with the assigned Case Manager, Patient Engagement and Sales to coordinate therapy initiation and ongoing patient support, align on patient-level logistical needs, and ensure a seamless experience for patients enrolled in PTC Cares.
  • Utilizes resources to empower patients and improve treatment compliance.
  • Identify and address adherence barriers (diet fatigue, taste preferences, social pressure, school/work constraints, access challenges, psychosocial factors).
  • Provide proactive follow-up based on program triggers, risk, missed check-ins, or patient-reported concerns.
  • Support transition milestones (e.g., increasing adolescent independence, transition to adult care teams, major life events that affect dietary adherence).
  • Coordinate with caregivers and healthcare providers, as appropriate and permitted, to reinforce plans and continuity of care.
  • Escalate urgent concerns, clinical red flags, or safety issues per program guidance and required reporting procedures.
  • Act as the PKU resource for Patient Services staff—answer questions, support complex cases, and provide coaching on patient communication approaches.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of PKU-specific workflows, scripts, and patient education tools.
  • Share themes and insights with leadership (e.g., common adherence barriers by age group) to improve services and patient experience.
  • Document all patient interactions accurately and in a timely manner in approved systems.
  • Maintain compliance with HIPAA/privacy requirements and PTC Cares program standards.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and support adherence/outcome tracking as defined by the program.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree and 5+ years of clinical nutrition/nursing and/or patient counseling experience with demonstrated adherence/behavior change support skills. Active, Dietitian/Nursing license and/or Master’s degree preferred.
  • Metabolic Dietician or Pediatric Dietician and/or nursing expertise with practical, real-world application across life stages.
