The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager.

The Corporate Counsel for Voyager Corporate is responsible for work closely with finance and business operations. This role will be responsible for providing legal counsel on a broad range of corporate matters, with a focus on commercial contracts and corporate governance. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in corporate law, preferably gained in-house or through a combination of law firm and corporate experience.

The position reports to the General Counsel and is part of the Legal department based in Denver, CO. This role is remote.

In this role, the essential functions are:

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, including customer and supplier contracts, teaming agreements, NDAs, licensing agreements, and services agreements
  • Advise on corporate governance matters, entity formation, capitalization, and internal reorganizations. Assist with corporate transactions, financings, and other strategic initiatives as needed.
  • Partner with the compliance and export control teams to ensure contracts align with regulatory requirements, including government contracting and international trade considerations
  • Develop and maintain contract templates, playbooks, and internal guidance to streamline the contracting process
  • Support post-acquisition integration activities, including aligning legal entities, contracts, and compliance obligations across the combined business.

If your experience aligns with our basic qualifications and you are inspired by our mission, we’d like to connect. If you don’t see the right role right now, Join Our Talent Community and stay connected as we continue to build what’s next.

  • J.D. from an accredited law school; licensed to practice law in the jurisdiction of residence/practice.
  • 4+ years of experience practicing corporate, contracts, or transactional law in an in-house legal department (strongly preferred) or at a law firm.
  • Excellent contract drafting and negotiation skills, with the ability to independently manage a high volume of agreements.
  • Familiarity with government contracting, export controls (ITAR/EAR), or the aerospace/defense industry is a plus, but not required
  • Excellent judgment, business acumen, and ability to communicate complex legal concepts clearly to non-legal stakeholders

Interested candidates should submit their application no later than Friday, September 25, 2026.

The good faith base salary range for this role is $200,000–$225,000 at the time of this posting. Where you fall within the range depends on your experience, skills, and location. This range reflects base salary only and does not include benefits or bonus/incentive. This range may be adjusted in the future.

Voyager offers a highly competitive total compensation package designed to support the well-being, growth, and success of our employees. Employees benefit from a flexible and comprehensive rewards program that supports both professional and personal well-being.

  • Flexible Time Off (FTO), empowering employees to take the time they need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families, with a significant portion of premiums covered by the company and many benefits paid at 100% for employees
  • Flexible, affordable gym memberships with 12,700+ options nationwide, including 24 Hour Fitness, EoS Fitness, Crunch Fitness, Anytime Fitness, Blink Fitness, Chuze Fitness, and more! No long-term contracts and FREE on-demand workout videos before you enroll
  • 401(k) retirement plan with a 50% company match on contributions up to 8%, supporting long-term financial security
  • Company wellness programs that support physical and mental well-being
  • Additional voluntary benefits and employee support resources
  • The opportunity to work alongside a highly talented team in an innovative, mission-driven environment

Voyager is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

The Product Lead Engineer serves as the technical authority across multiple Agile scrum teams inside a vertical product. This role carries no personnel management responsibilities but holds the highest technical voice within the team — setting direction, making implementation calls, and ensuring the team delivers reliable, well-engineered software. Beyond their own contributions, the Product Lead Engineer's output raises the technical capability of everyone around them.

Core Responsibilities

Technical Team Leadership

  • Serve as the technical authority within the development teams — making implementation decisions, resolving technical disagreements, and ensuring the team operates to a consistently high engineering standard.
  • Lead end-to-end delivery of complex features across backend, frontend, and mobile platforms — from design through deployment and monitoring — while actively guiding teammates through their portions of the work.
  • Decompose ambiguous requirements into well-scoped tasks; proactively identify and address technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and reliability risks.
  • Regularly and actively contribute production code (player-coach role) as a consistent, high-quality committer who models the engineering standards the rest of the organization is held to.

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews that improve quality and accelerate the growth of junior engineers.
  • Mentor Software Engineers through pairing, design discussions, and regular technical guidance.
  • Drive best practices for testing, branching, documentation, and security within the team.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product, QA, and Customer Success to clarify requirements, estimate accurately, and deliver reliable features on schedule.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively about technical risks, progress, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Technical Ownership & Cross-Training

  • Take primary ownership of one or more significant product areas — maintaining deep expertise in their architecture, behavior, and failure modes — and serve as the authoritative resource for decisions and issues in those areas.
  • Proactively lead knowledge transfer of owned areas to teammates so the team can operate effectively without any single engineer becoming a bottleneck.
  • Actively participate in cross-training led by others, developing meaningful familiarity with product areas outside primary ownership to strengthen overall team resilience.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, including production SaaS environments.
  • Deep proficiency in PHP and JavaScript / React, including design patterns, performance, and security best practices.
  • Strong command of relational database design, SQL optimization, and data modeling (MySQL / MariaDB).
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and upskill less experienced engineers.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tooling and workflows.
